quality.title: Post quality

level.good: Great post — everything is clear for candidates
level.ok: Good, but it could be even stronger

quality.all_good: Salary, location, schedule and description — all set.

tips.scam_words: The text suggests asking for money upfront (payment, deposit, collateral). Such posts are flagged as potential fraud and sent to moderation.
tips.contact_in_text: Remove phone numbers and links from the text — candidates can contact you safely inside the app.
tips.salary_missing: Listing a salary brings in more matching candidates.
tips.salary_suspicious: The salary is far outside the usual range — check the amount and payment type.
tips.description_short: Add 2–3 sentences to the description: duties and conditions.
tips.caps_title: Write the title without all caps — it's easier to read.
tips.shouting: Lots of exclamation marks and capital letters reduce trust.
tips.no_skills: Add 2–3 skills — the match score will be more accurate.
tips.no_address: Specify the district or address — nearby candidates will be found.
tips.wide_age: The age range is too narrow — it reduces the number of matching candidates.
